senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) guilt; guilt-offering, asham, a special kind of offering.—א׳ תלוי (Lev. V, 18) an asham to be offered when you are in doubt as to the commission of a sinful act.
units: Kerith. III, 1; a. fr.; (ib. 17ᵇ differ. opin. as to the nature of the doubt). Ib. VI, 3 אֲשַׁם חסידים the asham offered by the over-scrupulous because they may have transgressed.—א׳ ודאי the asham for the undoubted commission of certain offenses, which are:

senses.gloss: <he>אֲ׳ גזילות</he> for illegal appropriation of private property (after pecuniary reparation; <cite ref="Leviticus 5:25">Lev. V, 25</cite>);
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: <he>אֲ׳ מעילות</he> for misappropriation of sacred property (<cite ref="Leviticus 5:16">Lev. V, 16</cite>);
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: <he>אֲ׳ שפחה חרופה</he> for carnal connection with a slave betrothed to another man (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:21">Lev. XIX, 21</cite>) ;—
senses.label: c

senses.gloss: <he>אֲ׳ נזיר</he> offering of a nazarite when interrupting the days of vowed nazaritism by levitical impurity (<cite ref="Numbers 6:12">Num. VI, 12</cite>).—
units: Deut. R. s. 1, beg. (alluding to וַאֲשִׂמֵם Deut. I, 13) וְאַשְׁמָם כתיב it is so written that you may read v’ashmam (and their guilt); if you listen not to them אשמה תלוי וכ׳ (read אשמם) their guilt shall fall upon your heads (you will be answerable for what offenses they may commit); differ. in Sifré Deut. 13. [Our Bible editions, however, read ואשימם, plene.]—Pl. אֲשָׁמוֹת.
<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 6:4">Kerith. VI, 4</cite>. Sifré l. c.; a. fr.
senses.label: d
